title: Contact Enrichment Accelerator configuration
description: Drives generation of the tailored, deployable Contact Enrichment package. Usually produced by `enrich inspect` and refined by `enrich configure`.

companyName.description: Customer company name used in the AI prompt persona (e.g. 'Acme Corp').

companyDescription.description: Optional one-line description of the company/industry to ground the prompt persona (e.g. 'a global manufacturer of industrial equipment').

crmName.description: Display name for the CRM used in UI and prompt text. Defaults to 'Salesforce'; set to a brand name only if the customer white-labels their CRM.

webSearchProvider.description: Provider passed to the Salesforce 'Search the Web' data action.

webSearchQuery.description: Merge-field query expression used for the web search data action.

fields.description: Write-back target fields the AI may suggest updates for. Discovered from the org describe and confirmed by the user.

description.description: Short meaning shown to the model.

custom.description: True if a custom field (needs explicit FLS in the permission sets).

restrictedPicklist.description: True if a restricted picklist (suggested value must match an allowed value).

sources.description: Allowed provenance values written to the suggestion Source picklist.

linkedIn.description: LinkedIn Sales Navigator 'no longer at company' signal, wired in only when the field exists in the org.

departureFieldApiName.description: API name of the 'no longer at company' field (e.g. 'LID__No_longer_at_Company__c').

departureValue.description: Value that signals a departure (e.g. 'Not at Company').

statusFieldApiName.description: Status field to update on confirmed departure (e.g. 'Status__c').

statusDepartedValue.description: Status value meaning 'left this employer' (e.g. 'No longer employed here').

simulationField.description: Include the transient Enrichment_Source_Data__c scaffold + seed script to demo the ZoomInfo source before the ZoomInfo package is installed.

includeAutoCaptureFlow.description: Include the (inactive) record-triggered flow that auto-creates a departure suggestion from the LinkedIn signal. Requires linkedIn.enabled.

includeDemoPage.description: Include a clean demo Lightning record page (FlexiPage) with the widget + suggestions related list.

includeRetentionJob.description: Include the schedulable data-retention job that purges old dismissed suggestions.
